parsed.explanation: The write-up explicitly leaves finite generation of S_infinity as the remaining crux. Its bounded-gap and permanent-transversal lemmas do not prove that membership is controlled by one fixed finite prime set for all terms. The numerical stabilization checks also provide no all-cases argument. Establishing L6.2 therefore requires a substantive finiteness or large-prime-erasure lemma, not a local symbolic or sentence-level correction.
